quarterly_data.quarter: Sumitomo Bakelite press release: Development of High-Tg Epoxy Molding Compounds for (06-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Sumitomo Bakelite developed the SUMIKON EME-G785 Series epoxy molding compounds for next-generation SiC power modules and has commenced mass production. The series reaches a glass transition temperature (Tg) of 230°C (vs 195°C for its G720 and G780 series), which the company calls one of the highest levels in the industry for solid epoxy materials, while suppressing modulus increase to limit warpage, delamination and cracking. The company positions the G785 Series as a strategic product for next-generation power electronics and aims to achieve sales of ¥10 billion by fiscal year 2030.
quarterly_data.figure: Tg 230°C; mass production started; sales target ¥10 billion by fiscal year 2030
